settings.metaDescription: A comprehensive high school Bible course designed to establish deep roots of faith and understanding in today's students through engaging lessons, practical applications, and biblical truth.
settings.title: Rooted Instruction - Who is God, and What does it mean to be human

misc.title: Who is God, and What does it mean to be human

course-squares.description: Intention learning assignments and group assignments for when students meet with their homeschool coop.
Two live-streamed Q/A events a semester.
Documentation of how the course meets federal and state standards in awarding hour student credit.

course-squares-2.title: Who is God (Semester 1)
course-squares-2.description:
• There is only one true God.
  • God is a spirit (God is an "I" and not a thing).
  • The Personhood of God (Trinity).
  • The ultimate ends for which God created.
  • The excellencies of God in respect to His essence.
  • The excellencies of in respect to His character.

course-squares-2.title: What does it mean to be human (Semester 2)?
course-squares-2.description:
• The purpose for which God created mankind.
  • Created in His image.
  • What it means to be fallen.
  • Redemption and restoration.
  • How foundational human institutions reflect our being created in God’s image.
